# Kapil Pidhwani

> Kapil Pidhwani is a Revenue Strategy, Business Operations and AI operator (Google, ex-Amazon) and creator of the shipped solutions Fundingly.in and Toolity.in. Across 6+ years in global tech and enterprise operations, he has shipped 100+ GTM and AI workflow solutions, unlocked $10M+ in incremental revenue, automated 40+ hours per week of executive reporting and enabled 50+ enterprise accounts and pods.

## Selected Work (Transformations, Events & Solutions)

- [Amazon Rufus Rollout](https://kapilpidhwani.in/work/amazon-rufus-rollout/) (`Transformation`): Zero-to-one rollout of Amazon's Rufus AI shopping assistant to US childcare sellers in February 2024. Kapil pitched the concept, onboarded sellers and tuned listings.
  - **Skills Applied**: Go-To-Market Strategy, Sales Enablement, Product Marketing, Stakeholder Management, Change Management, Customer Experience, Data Analysis, Content Strategy, Training Design, Growth Strategy.
- [ACCA Onboarding Redesign](https://kapilpidhwani.in/work/onboarding-redesign/) (`Transformation`): At Mihir Infinite Services (ACCA account, 2023), Kapil rebuilt an eight-week new-hire programme into a four-week blended cohort (20% theory, 80% floor). New-hire QA rose from about 60 to above 85; adopted as the India standard.
  - **Skills Applied**: Training Design, Team Leadership, Operations, Process Design, Coaching, Stakeholder Management, Change Management, Customer Experience, Workflow Automation, Content Strategy.
- [Google Think Travel](https://kapilpidhwani.in/work/think-travel-2026/) (`Event`): Google India's flagship summit for travel and hospitality leaders on AI across the traveller journey. Kapil owned communications and visual design from the first invite to the closing slide.
  - **Skills Applied**: Event Marketing, Executive Communications, Brand Identity, Stakeholder Management, Content Strategy, UI/UX Design, Product Marketing, Market Research, Workflow Automation, Growth Strategy.
- [Fundingly.in](https://kapilpidhwani.in/work/fundingly/) (`Solution` · [Live](https://fundingly.in)): India's startup funding tracker and automated short-form media engine (`2,690+` verified rounds tracked across `21` quarterly tabs).
  - **Skills Applied**: Product Management, SEO, Workflow Automation, UI/UX Design, Web Development, Market Research, Data Analysis, Google Sheets, Content Strategy, Competitive Analysis.
- [Toolity.in](https://kapilpidhwani.in/work/toolity/) (`Solution` · [Live](https://toolity.in)): Suite of `180` lightweight, zero-bloat browser utility tools across Media, Docs, Labs, Dev, Data and Games running 100% client-side.
  - **Skills Applied**: Product Management, SEO, Workflow Automation, UI/UX Design, Web Development, Product Marketing, Prompt Engineering, User Research, Growth Strategy, Conversion Optimization.
